column1: # whenful join table — one row per task↔note link. TAB-separated. Starts empty.
#   task_id    — the Whenful task id (string), the key into mirror/<task_id>.md
#   note_slug  — the vault note this task belongs to, as folder/slug (e.g. projects/whenful)
#   step_label — OPTIONAL: a human label for which step of the note this task is (third column)
# Lines starting with # are comments. The plugin owns this file; the core never reads it.
